description.value: You've incorporated detritus and adhesive resin to your body to build temporary layers to your shell. As part of your daily preparations, you create either one commercial @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Compact Shield] or one commercial @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.equipment.Item.Carbon Shield] from detritus and your excretions. This shield can't be sold, repaired, upgraded, or altered in any way, and it disintegrates when you next make your daily preparations. You can use the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Shield Block] reaction with this shield.
